reason: The S9 persistent QCC telemetry client waits for HIDL1.2 unavailable on the retained S6 hardware layer, causing repeated startup ANRs. Disable-user was experimentally ineffective. Keep-data user removal is the validated runtime implementation.

restore.warning: Restoring the incompatible client can restore the known ANR loop; not exercised solely to repeat a known failure.

limitations: No byte-level read of protected QCC data; original recorded CE/DE inodes retained.
Current source images A84 still contain QCC and do not automatically apply this runtime policy.
Full ROM upgrade integration and clean-data boot remain pending.
No quantified FPS, power or memory improvement.
App UID is lab-specific; do not reuse it as a generic installer assumption.
future_ui9: Review the new QCC manifest/permissions/provider consumers and actual S6 service registration again; select the new donor APK identity. Reuse the capability isolation logic rather than the old binary or fixed app UID.
